title: my situation in the mountains is… not so good right now
en: even during eras of sadness in my life animals have always been a source of joy and healing the gentle wisdom and the demeanor of these creatures make me feel safe i always find it interesting how at our lowest points it can be so hard to look outside of ourselves and reach out to others be it a human or another type of animal and yet that is so often where healing begins i've had the pleasure of spending time on a few different horse ranches throughout my life once i spent 10 days in saddle string wyoming writing at dawn and dusk until

my backside was incredibly sore since i was a little girl i've always loved horses something about their soft eyes their power and their history in the american west has been alluring for as long as i can remember while i don't think we'll ever brag about it one thursday morning last week my town of barely more than 500 people made national headlines we had the worst air quality in the entire nation it's been an insane week and i really wasn't sure what to share with you because i didn't want this video to be overly sad i know so many people come to this channel to escape the realities of daily life

but as i was putting it together with my brother i realized that if it ends up being a bit sad then i guess that's okay sometimes things are sad and there's very little to see that is positive and yet even in that realization life can be ever more poignant reaching deep into our souls and grasping something there that is so incredibly human that it's hard to explain but i do know that it's a beautiful feeling sometimes tinged with fear and an awareness that you're losing so much of what you love but you're also most certainly alive to experience it it's fascinating and yet frightening i give thanks that i'm here in this town because i'm able to help others get through it and to practice love with even more conviction that it's crucial
during times like these during all times do today was no different my valley is in distress and i needed something to take my mind off things several new friends and i spent some

time walking through town sharing drinks and discussing the incredible dedication of our local smoke jumpers and firefighters it's so incredible to see people risking their lives to save our home no more than a speck on a map of course despite everything going on we need to attempt to at least lead our lives as we always have it makes no sense to sit on our porches and worry so when the winds changed and took away the smoke for one blessed morning we still hosted our farmers market in hopes of cheering up anyone who needed it it was so wonderful to connect and share smiles and laughs to exchange stories of

happier times knowing they will come again maybe it's a beautiful day after all of course i don't want to focus on these things too much so for the next several weeks i won't dwell anymore on the fires because life needs to continue and i will treasure every minute of it whoever you are and whatever type of day you've had be it good or difficult or somewhere in between i hope you never forget to give and receive as much love as possible because this week i've realized more than ever how important that is our material possessions our achievements even our very lives are fleeting and can disappear right now i have a whole new value for what it

means to be truly safe in the face of a monster of fire eating up my valley i see now that i will never take my safety for granted again and i hope you don't either oh thank you so much you're welcome if you wish to take action to protect

our lands as usual i will leave links below making changes in our own lives to help the environment is valuable but pressuring larger companies and organizations to have a change of heart is even more crucial for the future if you're falling asleep i'm sending you dreams full of sunshine and blue skies and clear air and most of all my love take care you
zh: 即使在我生命中悲伤的时期，动物也一直是欢乐和治愈的源泉，这些动物的温柔智慧和举止让我感到安全，我总是觉得很有趣，在我们的最低点，我们很难看到自己之外并接触他人，无论是人类还是其他类型的动物，但这往往是治愈的开始，一旦我在怀俄明州的马鞍弦上度过了十天的黎明和黄昏写作，我就很高兴在一生中的几个不同的马场度过了时光。直到
从我还是个小女孩的时候起，我的背部就非常酸痛。我一直很喜欢马，它们柔软的眼睛，它们的力量，它们在美国西部的历史从我记事起就一直很吸引人，但我想我们不会再吹嘘它了。上周的一个星期四早上，我的小镇只有 500 多人口，上了全国头条新闻，我们的空气质量是全国最差的，这是疯狂的一周，我真的不知道该与你分享什么，因为我不想让这个视频过于悲伤，我知道很多人来到这个频道是为了逃避日常生活的现实

但当我和我的兄弟把它放在一起时，我意识到，如果它最终有点悲伤，那么我想那没关系，有时事情是悲伤的，几乎没有什么可看到的积极的东西，但即使在这种认识中，生活也可以变得更加令人心酸，深入我们的灵魂，抓住那里的一些东西，它是如此令人难以置信的人性，很难解释，但我确实知道这是一种美丽的感觉，有时带有恐惧和一种意识，你正在失去很多你所爱的东西，但你也是最重要的我当然还活着去体验它，这很迷人，但也很可怕，我感谢我来到这个小镇，因为我能够帮助其他人度过难关，并更加坚信爱是至关重要的来实践爱
在这样的时刻，在任何时候，今天都没有什么不同，我的山谷陷入困境，我需要一些东西来转移我的注意力，几个新朋友和我花了一些时间
漫步在城镇中，分享饮料，讨论我们当地的救火队员和消防员的令人难以置信的奉献精神，看到人们冒着生命危险拯救我们的家园，只不过是地图上的一个斑点，真是令人难以置信，当然，尽管发生了一切，我们至少需要尝试过自己的生活，因为我们总是坐在门廊上担心是没有意义的，所以当风向改变并带走烟雾的一个幸福的早晨，我们仍然举办我们的农贸市场，希望能让任何需要它的人振作起来，联系真是太棒了分享微笑和笑声，交流故事

更快乐的时光知道他们会再来，也许这是美好的一天，当然，我不想过多关注这些事情，所以在接下来的几周里，我不会再沉迷于大火，因为生活需要继续，我会珍惜每一分钟，无论你是谁，无论你度过了什么样的一天，是美好的还是困难的，还是介于两者之间，我希望你永远不要忘记给予和接受尽可能多的爱，因为本周我比以往任何时候都更意识到我们的物质财富和成就是多么重要甚至我们的生命也转瞬即逝，现在就可能消失，我对它有了全新的价值
意味着面对吞噬我山谷的火焰怪物时真正安全，我现在明白了，我再也不会认为我的安全是理所当然的，我希望你也不会哦，非常感谢你，如果你想采取行动保护，不客气
我们的土地像往常一样，我将在下面留下链接，改变我们自己的生活，以帮助环境是有价值的，但向大公司和组织施加压力，让他们改变主意，对未来来说更为重要，如果你睡着了，我会向你发送充满阳光、蓝天和清新空气的梦想，最重要的是我的爱，照顾你
